From Highway to Hell · Price: you take the damage too.

Theme Fate

  • 1: Reaction, once per round: when you take damage, a creature within 30 ft takes the same damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}). This costs no Stand Point. Also, 1 action: share your wounds with a creature within 30 ft: it takes force damage equal to the Hit Points you're missing, up to @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}); on a critical failure it also shares your sickness: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}.
  • 5: Surge: you share your conditions too.
  • 9: Range 60 ft. Twice per day, when you share damage you take only half of it. The wound share's cap is @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]], and it can hit two creatures.
  • 13: The reaction can share with two creatures.
  • 17: You take half the damage you share, four times per day. The wound share's cap is @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]].

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
